saints.name: John of the Cross
saints.legacy: A guide to mystical union with God.
saints.summary: John of the Cross was a Spanish mystic and a major figure of the Counter-Reformation. He co-founded the Discalced Carmelites with Saint Teresa of Ávila and is known for his profound spiritual writings, which explore the soul's journey toward God. He was declared a Doctor of the Church in 1926 for his contributions to mystical theology.
